entry.title: Mempool.bitmixlist.org - the community mempool.space node
entry.summary:
The production mirror of mempool.space currently running is based on version 3.3.1, with changes limited to branding while maintaining identical functionality to the main site. This mirror utilizes [mempool/electrs](https://github.com/mempool/electrs) for its operations. The hardware configuration includes dual Intel(R) Xeon(R) Gold 6262V processors which slightly reduce memory bandwidth, 8x32 GB of DDR4 ECC RAM, and two 7.68TB NVMe SSDs configured in an LVM setup, optimized for performance due to a significant discount obtained on these drives. Additionally, the system benefits from a 10 Gbps public Ethernet connection and comprehensive Layer 3/4 DDoS protection.
For network and transaction services, the setup includes a separate Bitcoin node and an LND, though currently, it operates without open channels. Users interested in engaging with this infrastructure can access it directly through [mempool.bitmixlist.org](https://mempool.bitmixlist.org). For those seeking API access, the I2P URL is available, ensuring secure, anonymous connections. Moreover, there is an Electrum server powered by this mempool configuration accessible at [electrum.bitmixlist.org:50002:s](http://electrum.bitmixlist.org). These resources provide robust support for user transactions and interactions within the Bitcoin ecosystem, leveraging advanced server and protection mechanisms to ensure reliability and security.
